    e2 = norm(np.cross(u, ref)); e3 = np.cross(u, e2)
    th = np.deg2rad(109.471)
    out=[]
    for k in range(3):
        a = phi0 + k*np.deg2rad(120.)
        out.append(norm(u*np.cos(th) + np.sin(th)*(np.cos(a)*e2 + np.sin(a)*e3)))
